articles.title: The new CC, an AI agent built for families
articles.zh: 全新的 CC——为家庭场景打造的 AI agent
articles.summary: 如果你在找 agent 落地的垂直切口，Google 这次把家庭协作当成了新战场
articles.body:
The new CC, an AI agent built for families Sep 17, 2026

Google Labs introduces a new experimental agent built for families, helping households spend less time on logistics and more time together.

Senior Product Manager, Google Labs

Your browser does not support the audio element.

Google is launching an AI agent called CC to help families manage busy household schedules. You can invite up to six members to share information, allowing the agent to organize calendars, track tasks, and handle logistics like meal planning or registration forms. If you are in the U.S., look for an email to upgrade your account or join the waitlist to start using it today.

When we launched CC , our goal was to build a personal agent that helps you get ahead of your day. It quickly became a daily habit for many early testers and in May we brought it to the Gemini App as Daily Brief .

One of our top user requests was for CC to do more to help run a busy home. Between school schedules, sports practices, paying bills, and figuring out what’s for dinner, managing a household is often a shared responsibility with a lot of coordination, made even more challenging with information spread over multiple user accounts.

Today, CC is becoming an agent for families and households. It has its own Google account that gives CC a distinct identity and clear permissions model, enabling up to six members to manage and collaborate with the agent. CC only sees what each member chooses to share, such as emails from your child’s school, the local swim center, or the vet. It automatically sorts through them and creates a shared daily brief and connects to Calendar and Tasks, helping families spend less time coordinating logistics and more time just being together.

With shared context in one place, CC helps keep daily routines for groups such as families and households running smoothly:

Add family members to your CC and pull in relevant information for Your Day Ahead brief, delivered right to your inbox.

CC can automatically add calendar events based on what your family shares.

CC can take action, like filling out forms, with your permission.

Easily control what you share with CC.

CC is an early experiment from Google Labs, available on web and mobile for people (18+) in the U.S with a personal Google account. Existing users will receive an email in the coming days to upgrade their account and new users can join the waitlist .
articles.bodyZh:
新的CC，一个为家庭打造的AI助手 2026年9月17日

Google Labs推出了一款全新的实验性助手，专为家庭设计，帮助全家人少花时间处理琐事，多花时间在一起。

Google Labs高级产品经理

你的浏览器不支持音频元素。

Google正在推出一款名为CC的AI助手，帮助家庭管理繁忙的日常安排。你最多可以邀请六位成员共享信息，让这个助手来整理日历、跟踪任务，还能处理像规划 meals 或填写报名表这类事务。如果你在美国，留意查收邮件来升级你的账户，或者加入等候名单，今天就能开始用。

当初我们推出CC的时候，目标就是打造一个能帮你提前规划好一天的私人助手。它很快就成了许多早期测试者的日常习惯，到了五月，我们把它带到了Gemini App里，叫做Daily Brief。

用户反馈中最强烈的一个需求，就是希望CC能更多地帮忙打理繁忙的家庭事务。学校的日程、体育训练、交账单、想晚饭吃什么——管理一个家往往是需要分担的责任，涉及大量的协调配合，而信息又分散在多个用户账户里，这让事情变得更加麻烦。

现在，CC正在成为一个为家庭和住户服务的助手。它拥有自己的Google账户，这让CC有了独立的身份和清晰的权限模式，最多可以让六位成员来管理和协作使用这个助手。CC只能看到每位成员选择分享的内容，比如你孩子学校发来的邮件、本地游泳中心的通知，或者兽医的提醒。它会自动整理这些信息，生成一份共享的每日简报，并连接到Calendar和Tasks，帮助家人少花时间协调琐事，多花时间真正待在一起。

把共享的信息集中在一处，CC就能帮助家庭和住户这类群体保持日常节奏顺畅运转：

把家庭成员添加到你的CC里，就能把相关信息汇集到“你的一天”简报中，直接发送到你的收件箱。

CC可以根据家人分享的内容自动添加日历事件。

在你允许的情况下，CC还能替你执行操作，比如填写表格。

轻松控制你分享给CC的内容。

CC是Google Labs的一个早期实验项目，目前面向美国18岁以上、拥有个人Google账户的用户，在网页端和移动端均可使用。现有用户将在接下来几天内收到邮件来升级账户，新用户则可以加入等候名单。

articles.title: Combining Hierarchical Cognitive Process with Process Supervision for Interpretable Scene Safety Understanding
articles.zh: 结合分层认知过程与过程监督的可解释场景安全理解
articles.summary: 如果你在做自动驾驶或机器人场景安全判断，这篇把"为什么判定这里危险"的推理链做成了可解释的过程监督
articles.author: Zhiyun Jiang, Hanyong Wang 等
articles.body: Scene safety understanding plays a life-or-death role in situational awareness in various critical domains. Traditional methods that rely on learning direct mappings between scenes and safety levels often lack interpretability, limiting their reliability in critical applications. An effective approach to overcoming this challenge lies in interpreting human cognitive processes and equipping machine models with analogous cognitive capabilities. This work explores an effective way of integrating scene safety cognitive process modeling and process supervision. Specifically, we first construct a hierarchical cognitive safety structure, which motivates the development of a novel, high-quality scene safety understanding dataset based on multi-step reasoning with process labels. This dataset serves both as a benchmark and a resource to improve the safety reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), while also enabling a granular analysis of intermediate reasoning steps through information flow and saliency-based techniques. Building upon this foundation, we introduce a modular and flexible process supervision framework that reflects the hierarchical nature of human cognition. This framework leverages LLMs as the core architecture and incorporates Low-Rank Adaptation(LoRA) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) strategies to enable specialization and collaboration among expert modules, each tasked with specific sub-processes of the overall reasoning chain. Systematic experimental evaluations and analyses confirm that our framework exhibits superior interpretability and performance characteristics compared to traditional approaches.
articles.bodyZh: 场景安全理解在态势感知（situational awareness）中起着生死攸关的作用，这在多个关键领域都是如此。传统方法依赖于学习场景和安全等级之间的直接映射，往往缺乏可解释性，限制了它们在关键应用中的可靠性。克服这一挑战的有效方法在于解读人类认知过程，并赋予机器模型类似的认知能力。本研究探索了一种有效的方法，将场景安全认知过程建模与过程监督相结合。具体来说，我们首先构建了一个分层认知安全结构，这推动了基于多步推理和过程标签的新型高质量场景安全理解数据集的开发。该数据集既可作为基准，也可作为资源，用于提升大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全推理能力，同时还能通过信息流和显著性技术对中间推理步骤进行细粒度分析。在此基础上，我们引入了一个模块化且灵活的过程监督框架，该框架反映了人类认知的分层特性。该框架以LLMs为核心架构，并融入了低秩适应（LoRA）和专家混合（MoE）策略，以实现专家模块之间的专业化和协作，每个专家模块负责整个推理链中的特定子过程。系统的实验评估和分析证实，与传统方法相比，我们的框架展现出更优越的可解释性和性能特征。

articles.title: TimeInteract: Towards Real-Time Interactive Intelligence for Streaming Time Series
articles.zh: TimeInteract：面向流式时间序列的实时交互智能
articles.summary: 如果你在做时序预测但模型只能离线跑批，这篇给的是数据边来边交互的实时方案
articles.author: Sheng Pan, Yongli Gu 等
articles.body: Real-world time series evolve continuously, with meaningful changes potentially emerging at any moment. However, existing time-series language models (TSLMs) remain inherently static. They either receive complete sequences for offline processing or alternate between streaming input and response generation, which prevents processing of new observations during interaction. We introduce a new regime, Time-Series Interaction: a model continuously perceives incoming time-series observations and user intent, autonomously decides when to remain silent or respond, and continues processing new observations during response generation. To realize this, we develop TimeInteract with three key designs: a dual-view streaming TS encoder that captures local variations and historical dynamics, a response control mechanism that learns when to trigger a response, and a decoupled streaming inference mechanism that separates control from response generation to avoid blocking subsequent observations. We further formulate a hierarchy of interaction capabilities, progressing from Understanding to Adaptivity. Based on this hierarchy, we construct StreamTSI-34K, a large-scale streaming TS interaction dataset with 34,588 episodes and 77,505 responses across synthetic and real-world time series in single- and multi-turn settings. Across all four interaction levels, TimeInteract consistently outperforms existing LLMs, VLMs, and TSLMs, with gains of up to 23.92 points on challenging tasks. It also improves response triggering while achieving near-zero stream stall and up to $2.15\times$ inference speedup.
articles.bodyZh: 现实世界里的时间序列一直在变，有意义的变化可能随时冒出来。可现有的时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）本质上还是静态的：要么拿到完整序列后离线处理，要么在流式输入和生成回复之间来回切换，结果就是交互过程中没法处理新来的观测数据。我们提出一种新范式——时间序列交互（Time-Series Interaction）：模型持续感知不断传来的时间序列观测和用户意图，自己判断什么时候该保持沉默、什么时候该回应，而且在生成回复的同时还能继续处理新观测。为了实现这个目标，我们设计了 TimeInteract，关键有三点：一个双视角流式时间序列编码器（dual-view streaming TS encoder），既能捕捉局部变化，也能把握历史动态；一个响应控制机制（response control mechanism），学会什么时候该触发回应；还有一个解耦的流式推理机制（decoupled streaming inference mechanism），把控制和回复生成拆开，避免挡住后续观测。我们还进一步定义了一套交互能力分层，从理解（Understanding）一步步走到自适应（Adaptivity）。基于这个分层，我们构建了 StreamTSI-34K：这是一个大规模流式时间序列交互数据集，包含 34,588 个交互片段和 77,505 条回应，覆盖合成和真实时间序列，支持单轮和多轮场景。在四个交互层级上，TimeInteract 都稳定超过现有的大语言模型（LLMs）、视觉语言模型（VLMs）和时间序列语言模型（TSLMs），在高难度任务上最高提升 23.92 分。它还能更准地触发回应，同时把流式卡顿压到几乎为零，推理速度最高提升到 2.15 倍。

articles.title: On the Lexical Superstition of Large Language Models for Code Comprehension: Re-evaluation on Code of Low Lexical Quality
articles.zh: 论LLM在代码理解上的"词法迷信"：基于低词法质量代码的重新评估
articles.summary: 如果你用LLM做代码理解或代码审查，这篇提醒你模型可能过度依赖变量命名，碰上命名混乱的真实代码性能会掉
articles.author: Xin Shen, San-Zhuo Xi 等
articles.body: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made them widely used for code-related tasks. Identifier names are statistically informative in naturally occurring code, but their information is not always reliable. We investigate whether current LLMs assign disproportionate weight to lexical cues when renaming preserves program structure. We introduce Face/Off, a semantics-preserving identifier-renaming framework, and evaluate progressive naming conditions across multiple models and code-comprehension tasks. Within this framework, lexical overemphasis is pervasive across the evaluated models and primary tasks: performance generally decreases as identifier information is removed or made misleading, and outputs are often directed toward the meanings suggested by misleading names. The pattern persists under representative prompt- and fine-tuning-based interventions, suggesting that lexical overemphasis is an entrenched problem. A type-inference control confirms a boundary: naming effects are smaller when the answer is locally recoverable without the target name. These results do not imply that identifiers are unhelpful; rather, they reveal a systematic vulnerability in how current LLMs balance lexical cues against program structure. Our findings motivate evaluations and modeling methods that preserve the benefits of natural code regularities while keeping conclusions grounded in accurate, formalized code semantics.
articles.bodyZh: 最近这几年，大语言模型（LLMs）进步很快，已经被大量用来做跟代码有关的任务。现实里自然写出来的代码中，标识符名称（identifier names）往往在统计上能提供不少线索，但这些线索不一定可靠。我们想搞清楚一件事：如果在重命名时，程序结构保持不变，那现在的 LLM 会不会过度依赖词汇线索（lexical cues）？为此，我们提出了 Face/Off，一个在保持语义不变的前提下重命名标识符的框架（semantics-preserving identifier-renaming framework），并在多个模型和代码理解任务（code-comprehension tasks）上，测试了逐步递进的命名条件（progressive naming conditions）。在这个框架下，对词汇线索的过度侧重（lexical overemphasis）在受测模型和主要任务里都很普遍：只要把标识符信息拿掉，或者把它改得会误导人，模型表现通常就会变差，而且输出经常会被带向那些误导性名字暗示的意思。就算用上代表性的提示（prompt）和微调（fine-tuning）干预，这种模式依然存在，说明对词汇线索过度侧重是个根深蒂固的问题。一个类型推断对照实验（type-inference control）也确认了边界：如果不用目标名字，答案在局部就能推出来，那命名带来的影响就会小一些。这些结果并不是说标识符没用；它们反而说明，当前 LLM 在平衡词汇线索和程序结构时，存在一种系统性的脆弱点。我们的发现也促使大家去设计新的评估和建模方法：既保留自然代码规律（natural code regularities）带来的好处，又让结论建立在准确、形式化的代码语义（formalized code semantics）之上。

articles.title: Layout-Guided Masking for GROBID: Lightweight Structural Gains in Large-Scale Scientific PDF Ingestion
articles.zh: 面向GROBID的版式引导掩码：大规模科学PDF解析中的轻量结构增益
articles.summary: 如果你在批量解析论文PDF建库，这个改动成本很低但结构识别效果能提一截
articles.author: Luca Foppiano, Sana Khamassi 等
articles.body: Transforming scholarly PDFs into machine-readable fulltext remains a bottleneck for large-scale information systems. Recent vision-based parsers improve accuracy, but need GPUs and may introduce noise into the extracted text. GROBID, a modular font-stream parser running on CPU, is the de-facto standard for structuring scientific articles and underpins several of the largest open scholarly corpora. We pair it with a lightweight CPU detector localising figure, table, and paratext (header, footer, page number) regions, encoded as typed-area masks whose tokens are routed to GROBID's specialised models or discarded. On two PMC corpora, Bioinformatics (1,926 articles) and Materials Science (2,595), scored against JATS with a section-aware structural protocol, our extension improves over plain GROBID on most metrics (NS $+0.025$/$+0.013$; $+0.086$ paragraph recall on Materials Science, $d_z{=}1.08$), and caption-linked figure recovery improves on both corpora. On the external Table-BRGM benchmark, table detection recovers F1 $0.16 \to 0.94$ and table structure follows (GriTS-Top $0.27 \to 0.78$, below the strongest GPU system). On body text, against four vision-based systems (Docling, MinerU, olmOCR, dots.ocr), it has the best paragraph precision on both corpora, the best section detection on Materials Science, and a character error rate within 0.004 of the best GPU parser. End-to-end on CPU, it costs $2.7$--$3.2\times$ less than the cheapest GPU system (Docling) and $10$--$14\times$ less than generative parsers.
articles.bodyZh: 把学术PDF转成机器能读的全文，对大规模信息系统来说一直是个瓶颈。近几年基于视觉的解析器提高了准确率，但需要GPU，而且可能在提取的文本里引入噪声。GROBID是一个模块化的字体流（font-stream）解析器，跑在CPU上，是结构化科学文章的事实标准，支撑了好几个最大的开放学术语料库。我们给它配了一个轻量级的CPU检测器，用来定位图、表和副文本（页眉、页脚、页码）区域，编码成带类型的区域掩码（typed-area mask），这些掩码里的词元要么被送进GROBID的专用模型，要么被丢掉。在两个PMC语料库上——生物信息学（1，926篇文章）和材料科学（2，595篇）——用一套分节感知的结构评估协议（section-aware structural protocol）对照JATS打分，我们的扩展在大多数指标上都比原版GROBID有提升（NS +0.025/+0.013；材料科学上段落召回率+0.086，dz=1.08），而且图表标题关联恢复（caption-linked figure recovery）在两个语料库上都有改善。在外部Table-BRGM基准上，表格检测的F1从0.16提升到0.94，表格结构也跟着上来了（GriTS-Top从0.27到0.78，低于最强的GPU系统）。在正文文本上，跟四个基于视觉的系统（Docling、MinerU、olmOCR、dots.ocr）相比，它在两个语料库上都拿到了最好的段落精确率，在材料科学上分节检测最好，字符错误率（character error rate）与最好的GPU解析器差距在0.004以内。端到端跑在CPU上，成本比最便宜的GPU系统（Docling）低2.7到3.2倍，比生成式解析器低10到14倍。

articles.title: MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation
articles.zh: MAVP：面向移动操作的地图感知视觉运动策略
articles.summary: 如果你在做移动机器人抓取，这篇把地图先验塞进视觉运动策略，解决"走到哪、从哪抓"的协同问题
articles.author: Jinhe Tang, Ruixiao Dai 等
articles.body: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.
articles.bodyZh: 移动操作（mobile manipulation）想干得顺，底盘（base）和机械臂（arm）就得配合好，还得一直把空间位置掐准。可现实是，用示范数据训练出来的策略（demonstration-trained policies）经常没法稳稳做出想要的底盘动作，结果空间错位（spatial misalignment），后面的操作也跟着翻车。我们提出了 MAVP（Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies，地图感知视觉运动策略）：它会预测明确的底盘位姿目标（base-pose targets），再用定位反馈（localisation feedback）去追这些目标，从而让执行更靠谱。MAVP 会从遥操作示范（teleoperated demonstrations）里重建一张静态地图（static map），把示范中的底盘轨迹都放到同一个地图坐标系（map frame）里表示，这样不同示范之间就有了统一的空间监督（spatial supervision）。执行的时候，策略会接收 RGB 观测（RGB observations）、关节状态（joint states）和机器人当前在地图坐标系里的底盘位姿，然后一起预测目标底盘位姿、机械臂动作（arm actions）和夹爪动作（gripper actions）。底层控制器（low-level controller）会用前馈运动（feedforward motion）和位姿误差反馈（pose error feedback）来跟踪预测出的底盘目标，这样执行一旦跑偏就能及时纠正。训练时我们还加了位姿噪声增强（pose-noise augmentation），让策略对输入的位姿误差更稳、更抗干扰。在六个真实世界操作任务和三类策略家族（policy families）上，MAVP 在所有任务里的成功率都比不锚定的速度控制（unanchored velocity control）更高。视频和更多结果见 https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/。

articles.title: FairMean: Promoting Fairness in Distributed Learning under Label Poisoning Attacks
articles.zh: FairMean：标签投毒攻击下分布式学习中的公平性提升
articles.summary: 如果你在做联邦学习，这篇告诉你恶意节点投毒时公平性和鲁棒性会一起崩，以及怎么兜住
articles.author: Huigan Zheng, Jiaojiao Zhang 等
articles.body: Fairness-aware distributed learning prioritizes clients with large losses to reduce performance disparities, but label poisoning can create large losses, thereby inducing a fairness--robustness conflict. We propose FairMean to manage this conflict. FairMean weights client gradients using a bounded, nondecreasing function of local loss. The increasing weights prioritize high-loss clients to promote fairness, while the upper bound prevents excessive loss-induced amplification of poisoned-client gradients. In the absence of label poisoning, we show that minimizing the FairMean objective is more conducive to solution fairness than minimizing the standard average-loss objective. Under label poisoning, we establish an average-stationarity bound whose attack-dependent term is proportional to the square of the poisoned-client fraction. Experiments show that FairMean promotes fairness by reducing accuracy variance while improving worst-client accuracy.
articles.bodyZh:
公平感知的分布式学习（fairness-aware distributed learning）会优先照顾损失较大的客户端，以缩小性能差距，但标签投毒（label poisoning）可以制造出很大的损失，从而引发公平性与鲁棒性之间的冲突。我们提出 FairMean 来管理这一冲突。FairMean 用一个有上界且非递减的本地损失函数来给客户端梯度（gradient）加权。递增的权重会优先照顾高损失客户端，从而促进公平；而上界则能防止因损失过大而过度放大被投毒客户端的梯度。

在没有标签投毒的情况下，我们证明：最小化 FairMean 目标比最小化标准的平均损失目标更有利于实现解的公平性。在存在标签投毒时，我们建立了一个平均稳定性界（average-stationarity bound），其中依赖攻击的项与被投毒客户端比例（poisoned-client fraction）的平方成正比。实验表明，FairMean 通过降低准确率方差（accuracy variance）来促进公平，同时还能提升最差客户端的准确率。

articles.title: HySparse2: Hybrid Sparse Attention with Two-Level KV Sharing
articles.zh: HySparse2：带两级KV共享的混合稀疏注意力
articles.summary: 如果你在愁长上下文推理的显存和速度，这篇用两级KV共享做稀疏注意力，属于能直接抄的工程优化
articles.author: Jianyu Wei, Yizhao Gao 等
articles.body: Long-horizon and multi-turn agents typically generate short actions and process long observations from tools and environments. This growing context demands efficient prefill, compact KV-cache storage, and accurate long-context retrieval. To meet these demands, we introduce HySparse2, a hybrid sparse attention architecture with two-level KV sharing. At the outer level, KV Bridging adopts a YOCO-style self-decoder and cross-decoder structure, but bridges only full-attention layers. The self-decoder uses hybrid sliding-window attention (SWA), while the cross-decoder uses hybrid sparse attention. The KV caches for full-attention layers in the cross-decoder are generated from the hidden states of full-attention layers in the self-decoder. At the inner level, HySparse2 retains HySparse's core KV Reuse design with two refinements. First, it replaces block-level sparsity with token-level sparsity for finer long-context retrieval. Second, it removes the separate SWA branch from sparse layers and instead forces a sliding window of recent tokens into the sparse selection. This two-level KV sharing allows all cross-decoder KV caches to be constructed from self-decoder hidden states. Prefill can therefore exit after the self-decoder, skipping all cross-decoder layers. On an 80B-A3B MoE model, HySparse2 outperforms HySparse and Hybrid SWA on long-context retrieval and multi-turn agentic tasks, while substantially reducing prefill computation and KV-cache storage.
articles.bodyZh: 长周期（long-horizon）和多轮（multi-turn）智能体（agent）通常一次只生成很短的行动，却要处理工具和环境返回的超长观察结果。上下文越滚越大，就要求预填充（prefill）够快、KV 缓存（KV-cache）存得够省，还得能准准地检索长上下文里的信息。为了满足这些需求，我们推出了 HySparse2，这是一种带两级 KV 共享（two-level KV sharing）的混合稀疏注意力（hybrid sparse attention）架构。外层用 KV 桥接（KV Bridging），采用 YOCO 风格的自解码器（self-decoder）和交叉解码器（cross-decoder）结构，但只桥接全注意力层（full-attention layers）。自解码器用混合滑动窗口注意力（SWA, sliding-window attention），交叉解码器用混合稀疏注意力（hybrid sparse attention）。交叉解码器里全注意力层的 KV 缓存，是从自解码器里全注意力层的隐藏状态（hidden states）生成的。内层呢，HySparse2 保留了 HySparse 的核心 KV 复用（KV Reuse）设计，并做了两处改进。第一，把块级稀疏（block-level sparsity）换成词元级稀疏（token-level sparsity），这样长上下文检索更精细。第二，把稀疏层（sparse layers）里单独的 SWA 分支拿掉，改成强制把最近一段词元的滑动窗口（sliding window）塞进稀疏选择里。靠这种两级 KV 共享，所有交叉解码器的 KV 缓存都能从自解码器的隐藏状态构建出来。所以预填充（prefill）跑完自解码器就能退出，直接跳过所有交叉解码器层。在一个 80B-A3B 的 MoE（Mixture-of-Experts，专家混合）模型上，HySparse2 在长上下文检索和多轮智能体任务上，都比 HySparse 和 Hybrid SWA 表现更好，同时还大幅减少了预填充计算量和 KV 缓存存储。

articles.title: GitScholar: A Dataset for Predicting AI Research Impact from GitHub Engagement
articles.zh: GitScholar：基于GitHub互动预测AI研究影响力的数据集
articles.summary: 如果你关心怎么判断一篇AI论文会不会火，这个数据集把GitHub热度当成了影响力的先行指标
articles.author: Emilien Guandalino, Lorenz K. Müller 等
articles.body: With the rapid pace of AI research and the hundreds of daily new publications, staying up-to-date with the latest developments has become increasingly difficult. For researchers, quickly identifying impactful work is essential, yet manually reviewing each new publication is impractical. Automated impact prediction methods help address this challenge, usually by combining various information sources available, such as a paper's content or citation history. In this work, we propose using GitHub engagement as an additional source and demonstrate that it provides both a timely and accurate signal. To this end, we introduce GitScholar, a novel dataset that links GitHub activity from 444,000 repositories to over 558,000 AI arXiv papers. Our experiments show that GitHub reactions improve early prediction precision by up to 12% over a strong academic baseline. Additionally, we find that GitHub signal offers near-complete coverage of high-impact AI papers, and consistently correlates with future academic success. GitScholar is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/huawei-csl/GitScholar.
articles.bodyZh: 随着人工智能（AI）研究飞速发展，每天都有几百篇新论文冒出来，想跟上最新进展已经越来越难了。对研究人员来说，快速认出真正有影响力的工作特别重要，可要一篇篇手动看新论文，根本不现实。自动影响力预测（impact prediction）方法就是来帮忙解决这个问题的，通常靠整合手头各种信息源，比如论文内容或者引用历史。在这项工作里，我们提出把 GitHub 互动（GitHub engagement）也当成一个额外来源，并证明它能提供既及时又准确的信号。为此，我们推出了 GitScholar，这是一个新数据集，把来自 44.4 万个代码仓库的 GitHub 活动和超过 55.8 万篇 AI arXiv 论文关联了起来。我们的实验显示，相比一个很强的学术基线（academic baseline），GitHub 上的反应能把早期预测精度最多提高 12%。另外，我们还发现，GitHub 信号对高影响力（high-impact）AI 论文的覆盖率（coverage）接近完整，而且一直和未来的学术成功相关。GitScholar 已经公开，地址是 https://huggingface.co/datasets/huawei-csl/GitScholar。
